messages.author: 6e331217ab04e671
messages.subject: scale_fill_identity issue
parts:
Hello all,

I'm running R 2.10.1 with ggplot2 version 0.8.5. I am having issues
running scale_fill_identity, and it shows up running the example in
the documentation:

> colour <- c("red", "green", "blue", "yellow")
> qplot(1:4, 1:4, fill = colour, geom = "tile") +
+ scale_fill_identity(labels = letters[1:4], name = "trt")
Error: Labels can only be specified in conjunction with breaks

The only way I can clear the error is by specifying breaks = c(...)
but then I get a legend that has the breaks listed twice.

Regards,

Brian

messages.author: b756a7daa2c2aa6d
messages.subject: Re: scale_fill_identity issue
parts:
It should never have worked previously, due to all sorts of subtle
bugs that could creep in if the breaks were not what you were
expecting. Now you always need to specify the breaks if you are
specifying the labels.

The following works for me:

qplot(x, y, fill = col, data = df, geom = "tile") +
scale_fill_identity(breaks = colour, labels = letters[1:4], name = "trt")

Hadley
